summary: Selected the overlap of cross-review-surviving Fable Proposal 1 and Pro Proposal 2: the generic single-product-tag specialization, strengthened as the reviews require by auditing enlarged internal kernels. Its causal mechanism is that one leading product value a_j b_k in O/P = F_289 should separate every non-honest all-pairs movement. The exact breaker is a rectangle-kernel cancellation. Lean proves that any three proposed F_289 leading symbols, viewed as the two-dimensional F_17 space, have a nonzero F_17 linear dependency. In the deterministic asymmetric N=8 stress labeling, exact low-weight search finds an even shorter two-rectangle movement with centered coefficients (2,-1), integer row and column sums zero, product initial symbol (0,0), squared Frobenius weight 12, and support 6. Thus bare all-pairs marginals plus one F_289 leading coordinate fail the corrected internal-kernel gate. This does not establish reachability in an unspecified full Euclidean tile and does not refute extra independent tag coordinates or higher-grade constraints.
